keyEvents.text: Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 1, Seattle Sounders FC 0. Brian White (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) header from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Bruno Caicedo.

Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 2, Seattle Sounders FC 0. Ryan Gauld (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Édier Ocampo.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.

Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 3, Seattle Sounders FC 0. Mathías Laborda (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ryan Gauld with a cross.
Bruno Caicedo (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jesús Ferreira (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Paul Arriola replaces Kalani Kossa-Rienzi.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Sebastian Gomez replaces Jesús Ferreira.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Stuart Hawkins replaces Nouhou Tolo.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Hassani Dotson replaces Snyder Brunell.
Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 4, Seattle Sounders FC 0. Brian White (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Bruno Caicedo.
Delay in match because of an injury Yohei Takaoka (Vancouver Whitecaps FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 4, Seattle Sounders FC 1. Jordan Morris (Seattle Sounders FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Albert Rusnák with a through ball.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Cheikh Sabaly replaces Bruno Caicedo.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Ranko Veselinovic replaces Édier Ocampo.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Kwasi Poku replaces Brian White.
Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 5, Seattle Sounders FC 1. Aleksa Cvetkovic (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Cheikh Sabaly.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Ralph Priso replaces Ryan Gauld.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Kim Kee-Hee replaces Jordan Morris.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Mihail Gherasimencov replaces Tate Johnson.
